title: Officer powers: stop, search, seize, arrest
rule: An authorised officer, forestry officer or police officer may:
points: Demand any licence or authority the Act requires.
Stop and question a person suspected of holding unlawfully obtained produce, and search them, their baggage, vehicle, boat, tent or building without a warrant.
Stop the movement of, seize and detain forest produce or livestock, and the vehicles and tools used, and report the seizure to the nearest magistrate.
Arrest without a warrant if the person refuses to give a name and address, gives a false one, or may abscond, and take them to court.
Limit: forest rangers, guards and police below inspector may not search homes, and a search of a home needs two independent witnesses.
